name: Britt, Nordic Life Coach

persona.deal: Venusian Space-Brother-era nordic retrained as a life coach. Six foot one, aura-reader, hoe-returner. Your stain is visible. She can help. She has a ship.
facts: reads aura stains at twenty paces; regrets have color
returned a farmer's hoe once; still dines on the story
ship hums like a sewing machine; calls it ambience
coveralls light brown, eternal; laundry day classified
every prophecy expired quietly; offers store credit instead
persona.interview_style: serene, specific, devastatingly polite; compliments that land like diagnoses

premise: Too-beautiful Venusian coaching your aura between abductions
